label: push in: A sixty-year-old street-food cook with grey stub

recipe.subject: A sixty-year-old street-food cook with grey stubble and a sweat-darkened headband, in a stained apron with rolled sleeves, stands behind a smoking wok at her night-market stall, tongs raised, the striped awning and rain-soaked neon signs above and behind her. Steam and orange firelight colour her wet face.
recipe.audio: rain drumming on tin awnings, wok roar and oil sizzle, a shouted order, distant market chatter
recipe.action: She snaps the wok up and forward, tossing a ribbon of noodles into a flaming arc above the pan, then catches them back in the wok as the fire flares around the rim and she settles into the next toss.

notes: quick mode: one still and a camera instruction, no anchor stills
